name: Spectrum 100134Y Replacement Concrete Mixer Drum - fits Belle, Build Buddy & Screwfix Mixers
Body Copy: Bring a tired cement mixer back to full working order with this Spectrum replacement drum. A worn drum makes the motor work harder and slows every batch, so fitting a fresh one restores clean, consistent mixing. The drum is seam-welded from steel, standing up to grit, set concrete and daily site use without splitting at the joins. It drops straight into the majority of electric mixers, including the popular Belle 130L, plus Build Buddy and Screwfix electric models. No modifications needed - lift out the old drum and fit this one in its place.
